name: MusicDNA
subtitle: Your taste. A critic's take.
promotional_text: Start with three songs. Make a few tough choices. Meet a music critic with a point of view about what you keep choosing.
description:
Your favorite songs have something to say. MusicDNA gives them a critic.

Start with three songs that matter to you. Then choose between real songs in a short music interview. As you make your picks, the Critic offers a take on the choices, notices exceptions and gives you something to argue with.

PICK BY INSTINCT
Choose the song you would keep. Skip a matchup when you don't know the songs.

HEAR THE CRITIC'S TAKE
Get a reading grounded in your choices, with the supporting songs and unresolved tensions available to explore. See an initial reading after four answered choices, or keep going for the full interview.

TALK BACK
React when a take lands or misses. Continue the conversation from a saved reading and explain what the Critic missed.

KEEP OR SHARE YOUR READING
Return to your saved reading, explore the choices behind it and choose whether to publish a share link.

MusicDNA is an invitation to explore your taste. Readings are interpretations of the choices you make, and the conversation stays open.
whats_new:
A clearer, Critic-first reading experience.

- A halfway pause and an optional initial reading after four answered choices.
- Full readings with the twist, challenge and supporting evidence.
- Quieter, collapsed reaction controls below your song choices.
- Updated shared Critic backend and improved handling of longer responses.
